_comment: Canonical pin matrix for 00001-midnight-aa (PLAN-01 §Version pins). Every value is a concrete pin — nothing resolves `latest`, ever. Derived from /Users/edwardalvarado/compact-end-2-end/versions.json @ aa344546 (the beta.4 lane) and upgraded to the locked beta.6 lane per /Users/edwardalvarado/midnight-ref-ai/versions/v2.0.0-rc.4.json (lane decision 2026-08-10). infra/stack-up.sh reads docker.* from here into STACK.env; package.json pins npm.* exactly (no caret) and repeats them under `overrides` so exactly ONE copy of the ledger/onchain-runtime WASM is ever loaded.

docker._indexer_comment: NOT a stock release tag: the bridge-and-events branch build is the only image that serves the contractEvents / fieldPrefixes queries PLAN-01 G1.3 and PLAN-03/04 depend on. 4.4.0-rc.1 is the hosted-stagenet equivalent.
docker._proof_server_comment: The plain 9.0.0-rc.5 tag answers 'Unsupported ZKIR version' for zkir-v3. _experimental is a hard requirement of this whole project.

compact._features_comment: Every contract in this repo compiles with --feature-zkir-v3; ≤7 exported circuits per contract (deploy-tx verifier-key block-size limit).
compact._compiler_comment: 0.33.0-rc.2, NOT rc.1. PLAN-01's table names rc.1 for the image and rc.2 for the source build; rc.1 is unusable here — compactc 0.33.0-rc.1 crashes with `failed assertion cannot-happen at line 1088, char 25 of compiler/zkir-v3-passes.ss` on prove-ethereum-address-secp256k1.compact (in-circuit secp256k1EthereumAddress under --feature-zkir-v3), which is the exact primitive PLAN-03/04 depend on. rc.2 compiles it. compact-end-2-end also builds rc.2 (versions.json build.compact.ref = compactc-v0.33.0-rc.2), so rc.2 is the revision the upstream cases are actually proven against. Measured 2026-08-11 (G1.2).

_scope_comment: @midnightntwrk (no hyphen) is a DIFFERENT npm scope from @midnight-ntwrk. ledger-v9 1.0.0-rc.3 carries the keccak(x‖y) 62+-byte fab-decode fix — never downgrade it.

node._comment: ledger-v9 WASM needs Node >= 22. Bun may launch, but vitest/WASM run under Node. On Node 24 the indexer drops keep-alive sockets with `Premature close` — src/providers.ts disables the global agents.
